    Bug 1923587 - ship bounce-tracking-protection-exceptions dump in thunderbird. r=tobyp
    
    
    curl https://firefox.settings.services.mozilla.com/v1/buckets/main/collections/bounce-tracking-protection-exceptions | python -m json.tool | sed 's/    /  /g' | cat > mail/app/settings/dumps/thunderbird/bounce-tracking-protection-exceptions.json
    
    Then add timestamp (as it's are required) and make data an array.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D226976
